title: Prince George TSA biodiversity order
description: 2004 instrument. Case-specific geographic and legal applicability needs review. D.5 pathways are independent of FPPR §64.

facts.label: Reviewer verified the order applies to the footprint, tenure, date and plan, including exclusions and supersession

relatedPacks.relationship: Assess applicable FPPR requirements separately for the same operation. D.5 does not decide a section 64 exception.

rules.title: Young-forest distribution as a whole
rules.finding: The distribution as a whole moved farther from the Table 7 targets over the interval. Review all classes, land coverage, geography and method.

actions.description: Compare patch structure, locations and schedules across periods, including the classes that moved away. Record the professional interpretation of trend.

rules.title: Old or old-interior forest recruitment
rules.finding: An old-forest recruitment strategy is required under the entered circumstances.

actions.description: Document the shortest practicable recovery strategy, considering timely and economic harvesting of timber rights.
Record approval by the responsible designate.
Track the commitments and evidence of performance.

rules.title: Young-forest patch rationale
rules.finding: The entered determination calls for submission of a rationale.

actions.description: Describe results or strategies for reaching a consistent forest condition in the shortest practicable time, considering timely and economic harvesting of timber rights.

rules.title: OGMA, park or protected-area contribution
rules.finding: OGMA, park or protected-area contribution requires supporting evidence.

actions.description: Verify established objectives, footprint, overlap and the contribution permitted by D.1.

rules.title: Combined mBEC requirements across districts
rules.finding: Combined mBEC requirements across districts requires supporting evidence.

actions.description: Verify similar mBECs, the licensee and area in multiple districts, and reconcile combined requirements for A and B.

rules.title: Affected and unaffected stands
rules.finding: Affected and unaffected stands requires supporting evidence.

actions.description: Document representativeness. Review the requirement for an unaffected non-pine component under the described MPB epidemic.
Quantify each objective separately, establish equal or better conservation benefits and check the 20% ceiling.

rules.title: Transition or subsequent order
rules.finding: Transition or subsequent order requires supporting evidence.

actions.description: Check Category A approval date, the plan regime, affected area and effective date of the new order. Reassess applicability before using A–D.

rules.title: Old forest retention younger-age ceiling
rules.finding: The proposed younger-age contribution exceeds 20% of this objective.

actions.description: Reconcile the proposed younger-age hectares and objective denominator. Any contribution within the ceiling still needs evidence of equal or better conservation benefits.

rules.title: Old interior forest younger-age ceiling
rules.finding: The proposed younger-age contribution exceeds 20% of this objective.

actions.description: Reconcile the proposed younger-age hectares and objective denominator. Any contribution within the ceiling still needs evidence of equal or better conservation benefits.
